display_long_description:
Grab a paddle, hop in a boat, and get ready for a little sabotage. **[Paddle or Prank]** brings deathrun to the water, with hands-on rowing and players on both sides of the chaos.

**We’re confident: most of your time in this game will be highlight-reel material!**

**[Discord]** https://discord.gg/onceupon-inc

.
# Paddle Hard, Prank Harder!

**Be the Paddler—or the Problem**
[media]
As a Paddler, row through the course, dodge obstacles, and survive the other side’s attacks.
[media]
As a Prankster, you’re the one causing trouble. Attack the opposing crew and put an end to their run.

**Pick Your Kind of Chaos**

- Face off in **1v1**, share the rowing in **2v2**, see how far you can go together in **co-op**, or take your own boat into **deathmatch**, where eliminated players become Pranksters. Getting knocked out doesn’t mean you’re done.

**Put Your Arms Into It**

- Your paddle does the work. Pull through the water to move, steer with your strokes, and swat away incoming attacks. Staying afloat takes more than speed.

**Bring Some Personality**

- Play as a fox, gorilla, crow, or dolphin, and unlock boats and paddles to make your crew stand out.

Row for your life. Or ruin someone else’s ride.
